summary: RELEASE BLOCKER. Commit 36f972cf restamped release-baselines to the 1.3.0 manifests BEFORE 1.3.0 shipped, so every rebuild emits a 1.3.0-to-1.3.0 update delta (windows 970KB vs the correct 451MB). v1.2.0 does attach update zips to its GitHub release, so these are real assets. Fix: restore baselines to 36f972cf~1, rebuild, verify fromVersion 1.2.0, publish, restamp afterwards. New FULL artifacts are valid and in place; stale update zips quarantined.
